jobs.name: 클래식 아케이드
jobs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE polished fullscreen TITLE / MAIN MENU concept image for the Korean PC pixel-art roguelike shooter "RUSHITADEL". Landscape 16:9, target 1920x1080 composition. This is a single complete game screen, not a contact sheet, not a presentation board, not a device mockup.
Existing game identity: top-down scrolling battlefield between two rocky cliffs; a single circular silver and dark-violet mechanical player body with a luminous violet central core and EXACTLY FIVE attached short radial gun turrets, no human character, no castle, no separate fortress. Biomes include grassy rock, ice, magma, water and electricity; chunky angular robot bosses. Match hand-authored, crisp pixel-art game graphics: visible square pixel clusters, hard stepped outlines, restrained dithering, matte materials, 3-5 shade ramps, limited palette. All illustration AND UI must feel pixel art, not smooth 3D or vector web design.
UI requirements: title reads exactly "RUSHITADEL" (R U S H I T A D E L), prominent and fully legible. Main actions exactly "게임 시작", "이어하기", "설정", "게임 종료". Korean labels clean and readable at practical large button size. Game start is selected; continue is visibly disabled in a dim but readable state. Create a reusable pixel UI visual language whose panel frames, selected state and icons could later support settings, Web upgrade and augment selection screens. Only the title screen now, no upgrade menus or invented gameplay statistics.
Avoid: people, six-barrel player, castle imagery, mobile app chrome, rounded glass cards, photorealism, polished glossy 3D, microscopic illegible text, marketing slogans, watermarks, contact sheets, numbered concept captions inside image. Keep generous safe margins and strong text/background contrast.

Concept: classic centered arcade title. Symmetrical top-down indigo rocky corridor with quiet texture, long vertical cliff edges and a small violet five-turret player sprite in the lower foreground. Large ivory pixel-block title with a restrained lavender offset shadow across upper third. Four solid dark-navy beveled pixel buttons stacked in the center; bright violet outline and a tiny triangular pixel cursor for selected start. Sparse red robotic silhouettes high in the distant corridor as subtle framing only. Make readable UI the focal point, balanced purple/silver matte palette. A direct evolution of the game's battle screen into a welcoming title.
